method.referenceChecks: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods: sections 6.6.1.2 and 6.6.1.3 (lithography case study), 6.3.2.1 (factor table), 6.3.2 (c4), 6.3.2.2 (individuals chart example) and 6.1.6 (capability example and rejects)
method.factors: d2 and d3 from the distribution of the range of n normal observations, Simpson's rule with step 0.01; A2 = 3 / (d2 sqrt(n)), D3 = max(0, 1 - 3 d3 / d2), D4 = 1 + 3 d3 / d2
method.controlLimits: X-bar and s, and X-bar and R, three-sigma limits (6.3.2.1) with the wafer as subgroup; individuals chart (6.3.2.2) on the cassette means
method.varianceComponents: Nested random-effects analysis of variance, mean squares equated to expected mean squares (6.6.1.3)
